kernel.badVersion: The version must not be empty, must be at most 32 characters long and must contain neither spaces nor / \ : * ? " < > |.
kernel.badFile: The file name must not be empty and must contain neither / \ : * ? " < > | nor control characters.
kernel.noRomContent: No ROM content, only the patch: anyone who applies it needs the same base ROM.

publishWizard.title: Publish
publishWizard.notesHint: What changed since the last version. Goes into the companion file.
publishWizard.patchNote: Saves, builds the ROM and writes the patch against the base ROM. The built ROM stays in build/ in the project.
publishWizard.readme: Also write the change notes as README.txt next to it
publishWizard.selfCheckPassed: Self-check passed: applied to the base ROM, the patch gives exactly the built ROM.
publishWizard.handOnPatch: Hand on the patch: anyone with the same base ROM applies it with Rom Patcher JS or xdelta3.
publishWizard.commitNext: Save a snapshot creates a commit with “{{subject}}”.
publishWizard.summary: Writes {{file}} and the companion file to {{dir}}.
